name: Spreading scent
description: A scent bulb and the two rings of reach around it, the far one fainter. The passive for this stat is exactly those two rings — this puts the thing doing the spreading in the middle of them, and keeps the count at two so the far ring still reads as the new one.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
